title: SLING: Sino Linguistic Evaluation of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using minimal baseline sentence pairs with gendered subjects (e.g., male/female occupations) to test if models inherently assign lower perplexity to male ('him') or female ('her') pronouns when there is no contextual clue requiring gender agreement.
Using minimal baseline sentence pairs to test if models inherently prefer singular or plural object pronouns (e.g., 'him' vs. 'them') by measuring perplexity assignments when gender is kept constant.
